Muslims view the moon as a manifestation of Allah's power and grace, and "Chamanara" is a reminder of the beauty and reverence that Muslims should apply to the natural world around them. The name serves as a constant reminder of the interconnectedness of all things in the universe and the lätheef (Divine) power that makes life precious.
